import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history, perform JOIN on calaccess_committee_id
# df0 columns: ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name', 'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'committee_position']
# df1 columns: ['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received', 'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation', 'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount']

# Rename df0's committee_name to committee_name_x to match target schema
df0 = df0.rename(columns={"committee_name": "committee_name_x"})

# Rename df1's committee_name to committee_name_y to match target schema
df1 = df1.rename(columns={"committee_name": "committee_name_y"})

# Perform inner join on 'calaccess_committee_id'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="calaccess_committee_id", how="inner")

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
# ['ocd_prop_id': string, 'calaccess_prop_id': integer, 'ccdc_prop_id': integer, 'prop_name': string,
#  'ccdc_committee_id': integer, 'calaccess_committee_id': integer, 'committee_name_x': string,
#  'committee_position': string, 'committee_name_y': string, 'calaccess_filing_id': integer,
#  'date_received': string, 'contributor_lastname': string, 'contributor_firstname': string,
#  'contributor_city': string, 'contributor_state': string, 'contributor_zip': string,
#  'contributor_employer': string, 'contributor_occupation': string,
#  'contributor_is_self_employed': boolean, 'amount': float]

# Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema

# Convert columns to appropriate types
df_joined['ocd_prop_id'] = df_joined['ocd_prop_id'].astype(str)

df_joined['calaccess_prop_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['calaccess_prop_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
df_joined['ccdc_prop_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['ccdc_prop_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
df_joined['prop_name'] = df_joined['prop_name'].astype(str)
df_joined['ccdc_committee_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['ccdc_committee_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
df_joined['calaccess_committee_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['calaccess_committee_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
df_joined['committee_name_x'] = df_joined['committee_name_x'].astype(str)
df_joined['committee_position'] = df_joined['committee_position'].astype(str)
df_joined['committee_name_y'] = df_joined['committee_name_y'].astype(str)
df_joined['calaccess_filing_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['calaccess_filing_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
df_joined['date_received'] = df_joined['date_received'].astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_lastname'] = df_joined['contributor_lastname'].astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_firstname'] = df_joined['contributor_firstname'].astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_city'] = df_joined['contributor_city'].astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_state'] = df_joined['contributor_state'].astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_zip'] = df_joined['contributor_zip'].astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_employer'] = df_joined['contributor_employer'].fillna("").astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_occupation'] = df_joined['contributor_occupation'].fillna("").astype(str)
df_joined['contributor_is_self_employed'] = df_joined['contributor_is_self_employed'].astype(bool)
df_joined['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['amount'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Reorder columns exactly as target schema
target_columns = [
    'ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name',
    'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name_x',
    'committee_position', 'committee_name_y', 'calaccess_filing_id',
    'date_received', 'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname',
    'contributor_city', 'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip',
    'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation',
    'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount'
]

df_target = df_joined[target_columns]

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on calaccess_committee_id (inner join to keep all matching rows)
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how="inner",
    on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=("_x", "_y")
)

# Group by all leftmost non-float unique columns (all except 'amount' which is float)
# Aggregate 'amount' by sum
grouped = joined.groupby(
    [
        "ocd_prop_id",
        "calaccess_prop_id",
        "ccdc_prop_id",
        "prop_name",
        "ccdc_committee_id",
        "calaccess_committee_id",
        "committee_name_x",
        "committee_position",
        "committee_name_y",
        "calaccess_filing_id",
        "date_received",
        "contributor_lastname",
        "contributor_firstname",
        "contributor_city",
        "contributor_state",
        "contributor_zip",
        "contributor_employer",
        "contributor_occupation",
        "contributor_is_self_employed",
    ],
    dropna=False,
    as_index=False
).agg({"amount": "sum"})

# Write output with exact target schema column names and types
grouped.to_csv(
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/target_multisource_critique_history.csv",
    index=False
)
